decisions.reason: It has remained visibly marketed since its 2023 launch and fits the firm's core dental-lab equipment capabilities, so its results likely meet or are close enough to aspiration levels to justify retention.

Because this product is distant from the firm's established offer, any early performance shortfall is less likely to be tolerated and management would likely redirect resources to better-matching businesses or development projects.

Although still new and only lightly featured, it is close to the firm's digital manufacturing workflow and certified production strengths, so organizational slack would support keeping it while results remain uncertain.
